description: The server renders the React tree to HTML on every request; the client then hydrates it.
`hydrateRoot` renders the same tree on the client, adopts the existing DOM nodes and attaches event listeners. Requires an identical first render.
The data the server rendered with, embedded in the HTML (for example a `type="application/json"` script) so the client hydrates without refetching.
`JSON.stringify` leaves `</script>` intact; embedding it in HTML closes the tag early. Escape `<` as `\u003c`.
Time to first byte. SSR raises it because data loading and rendering happen before the response starts.
First and Largest Contentful Paint. SSR improves them over a SPA because content arrives in the first response.
`renderToPipeableStream` / `renderToReadableStream` send the shell first and stream `<Suspense>` boundaries as their data resolves.
